errors.text_span: Die lila Linie mit Kreuz-Markierungen (durchgezogen) beginnt bei 0
errors.evidence: In the left panel the purple solid line starts around 0.1–0.15 in 1995, not at 0.
The blue solid line in the left panel is closer to about 0.2 in 2018; 0.1 is a slight underestimation.
The purple solid line in the left panel ends around 2.0 in 2020, not 1.9.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Dreiecke (gestrichelt) repräsentieren die Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat
errors.evidence: The debt-quote marker series in the left panel are blue upward triangles, but they are not described as the only dashed/marker series; more importantly the description implies a single series mapping, while the figure contains both blue and red triangle marker series on the same right axis, each with different values.
The red triangle series for Gesamtstaat is approximately 58–59 around 2000, not 88.

errors.text_span: bleiben bis 2019 bei 100 und fallen 2020 auf 98
errors.evidence: The red triangle series for Gesamtstaat is around 100–101 by 2019 and about 99 in 2020; 98 is slightly off.
In the right panel the purple solid line also has no cross markers; the figure shows a plain line, not X markers.
The blue solid line in the right panel is slightly above zero around 2018 rather than exactly 0.0.
The purple solid line in the right panel starts around -0.1 to -0.2 in 1995, not at -0.5.
The blue triangle debt series for Zentralstaat is at about 70 in 2020, not 68.
The red triangle debt series for Zentralstaat is around 49–50 in 2020, not 57.
